parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description: The domain name. This parameter supports only term queries.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Use a UNIX timestamp that is accurate to the second.

parameters.name: IsAITraffic
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to count only the traffic generated by accessing AI services. The default value is false. Valid values:

- **true**: Yes

- **false**: No

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese. This is the default value.

- **en**: English

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The field to sort by.

Default value: TotalBytes.

Valid values:

TotalBytes: Sorts the results by total traffic.

SessionCount: Sorts the results by the number of sessions.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: The sorting order. Valid values: asc (ascending) and desc (descending).

parameters.name: SrcIP
parameters.description: The source IP address that is used to access the domain name.

parameters.name: SrcVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the source VPC.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. Use a UNIX timestamp that is accurate to the second.
